title: Challenger Life No.2 Limited - proposed acquisition of the existing annuity policy, personal superannuation and allocated pensions business of MetLife Insurance Limited

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines
Closing date for submissions from interested parties
ACCC announced it would not oppose the proposed acquisition

body_sections.Summary: Challenger Life No.2 Limited proposes to acquire the existing annuity policies of MetLife Insurance Limited.
body_sections.Market definition: This merger was assessed within the context of the national markets for the manufacture and supply of i) long-term annuities, and ii) short-term annuities.
body_sections.Competition analysis: On 18 April 2007, the ACCC formed the view that the proposed acquisition was unlikely to result in a substantial lessening of competition in the relevant markets. Factors informing this conclusion included: - There remain a number of sizeable competitors in the two markets, who are likely to act as a strong competitive constraint on the merged firm. - Financial intermediaries exercise a significant degree of countervailing power, which is also likely to constrain the merged firm. - Impending regulatory changes mean that annuity providers in the relevant markets will face competition from a wider range of products.
